selectionDecision.recommendation: reject tail06 as the unified two-provider product change in this round; retain integrated05
selectionDecision.reason: The pre-recorded repeatability condition was not met across both providers. SQLite mixed CPU and scheduled latency reverse direction; prior SQLite early-stop and 1000-row risks remain unexplained. PG CPU/tail observations improve but released RSS increases in both rounds. This is not a claim that tail06 is universally slower.
